site.title: Zaydoun — AI Voice Assistant for Books | Chat with Any PDF
site.description: Zaydoun is an AI-powered voice reading assistant. Upload any PDF, ask questions hands-free, and get page-accurate answers in 5 languages. Powered by RAG, Whisper STT, and GPT-4o mini.
site.ogDescription: Upload any PDF and have a deep, voice-first conversation with it. Page-accurate answers in 5 languages — hands-free.
featureList: 5 reply languages: English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Chinese

features.title: Features — AI Voice Reading Assistant with RAG & Whisper STT
features.description: Explore Zaydoun's features: page-accurate answers, voice transcription, spoken replies, 5 reply languages and PDF indexing. Built for serious readers.

howItWorks.title: How it works — From a PDF to a conversation
howItWorks.description: How Zaydoun reads your PDF page by page, finds the passages that answer your question, replies with the page it used, and talks back on mobile.

faq.title: FAQ — Questions about Zaydoun
faq.description: Answers about uploading PDFs, page citations, reply languages, hands-free voice, free limits, your account and privacy.

contact.title: Contact — Talk to the Zaydoun Team
contact.description: Have a question, bug report, or feature request? Every message is read by a real person — we reply within one business day.
